Fix a firm persistent gaze on the back of the head at the base of the brain.
Will the person to turn and look at you.

originalProcedureParaphrase: Select a person across the street, slightly to the right or left of directly opposite.
Look ahead without appearing to watch the person, while keeping them in the field of view.
Direct an unyielding mental demand that the person look toward you.

records.normalizedEnglish: Begin with easy tasks and gradually move to harder ones; do not wrinkle the brow or clench fists, remain calm, express a gentle persistent demand and expect fulfillment. Concentration is recommended. The source blames difficulty on insufficient concentration; this is not a validated assessment or app gate.

The author recalls an unnamed German-translated work about a student allegedly steering oral examination questions, then failing to do so when questions were set in writing. No identified study, exercise protocol or independently confirmed outcome.

The author calls these minor preparatory experiments, encourages further variants and frequent practice, and discourages entertainment or public demonstrations, preferring private knowledge and good intentions. No fixed frequency or consent protocol is provided.
